interest fee of 2.0% per month (or 24% per annum pro-rata) on the outstanding principal.

vendor billing errors.

4.3 Overdue Escalation Workflow
Phase 1 (Day 1 to 14 Overdue): Automated reminder notification generated by ERP and
dispatched to vendor relationship manager.
Phase 2 (Day 15 Overdue): Mandatory escalation meeting between Finance Controller and Vendor
Account Lead. Accounts Payable freezes new purchase order issuance to the vendor.
Phase 3 (Day 30+ Overdue): Formal dispute review and legal notification protocol activated.

2.3 Dispute Resolution and Hold Protocol
If an invoice contains discrepancies, Accounts Payable must notify the vendor within seven (7)
business days of invoice receipt.
The disputed portion will be placed on administrative hold, while undisputed amounts under the
same invoice must be paid per schedule.

cited_chunk_text:
[payment_policy.pdf, p.1, §1.3 Payment Methods and Routing]:
1.3 Payment Methods and Routing
All domestic vendor disbursements exceeding ₹2,00,000 must be routed via Real Time Gross
Settlement (RTGS).
Payments between ₹10,000 and ₹2,00,000 are processed via National Electronic Funds Transfer
(NEFT) or Immediate Payment Service (IMPS). Physical cheque issuance is prohibited except for
court-mandated statutory deposits.
